snippet.title: How to Stand Up to Cultural Pressure on Abortion and LGBTQ+ Issues
snippet.description:
In this important discussion from the Jubilee Church Podcast, Lead Pastor Bryan Mowrey talks about staying true to biblical convictions while showing compassion in a culture that pressures Christians to conform.

Bryan explores how Christians can respond to cultural hot-button issues with courage and clarity, rooted in God’s Word, while still extending grace and truth to others.

📺 Watch the full conversation here: https://youtu.be/1LiRKQHHUmU

Tags: cultural pressure, abortion and Christianity, LGBTQ and Christianity, biblical convictions, standing firm in faith, christian worldview, grace and truth, christian cultural engagement, jubilee church, christian podcast
